bh-n.label: Deliveries in Delhi Capitals' matches
bh-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bh-n.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN c.length IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) len, SUM(CASE WHEN c.shot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) shot, SUM(CASE WHEN c.zone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zone, SUM(CASE WHEN c.line IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) line, SUM(CASE WHEN c.speed_kph IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) spd, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) matches FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE (i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) OR i.bowling_team_id IN (8,11)) AND i.innings_number <= 2
